title: Identify European Blue Screw source plan
platforms: European ROM; Windows via Wine and static analysis
changes: Record source contracts for three observed literals and a 15-entry switch array covering the Blue Screw sample residual; runtime ownership remains open.
validation: Wine disassembly __998l61 and protected source plan jkaucm5o authenticate original opcodes, root and selector path, 72 disjoint source bytes, target shapes and all 24 sampled bytes. Wine drained.
limitations: Captured scopes can include nested reads; other callers and scenes remain open. Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No performance comparison was performed.
